info.title: Netriun Nexus API
info.description: Multi-tenant workspace API with live provider refresh, database snapshots, custom account access policies, local verified-email authentication, and workspace-scoped OIDC/SAML SSO. Lists return {data: [...]}; errors return {error: message}. Login tokens expire after 12 hours. Community workspaces include one owner and five additional users. The workspace owner retains local break-glass access when SSO is required.
